text:
incident-bot: Pager -> GPU OOM spike on prefill path in us-west-2. 40+ container restarts in the last 5m. Severity: P1. Paging oncall-sre.

maria: seeing it on the dashboard, prefill p95 token count shooting up. appears correlated with a single customer sending very long context requests.

sam: confirmed. logs show repeated OOMs before container exits. stack traces point at kv-cache allocation during prefill. patching model doesn't help; it's runtime mem pressure.

noah: @oncall-sre i'm on it. what's the impact to customers?

oncall-sre: customer-impact: a handful of requests returning 500 / reconnects; overall latency not affected for short prompts, but long-context customers seeing failures. sending initial update to SRE inbox.

maria: quick mitigation idea: disable prefill-parallelism on the affected node pool and reduce concurrency for that deployment. can we cordon the misbehaving nodes?

eng-infra-bot: Suggested run: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-7 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data gpu-node-7`

sam: prefer not to drain all at once. recommend isolate by label: `kubectl label nodes gpu-node-7 quarantine=oom` then update routing policy to avoid that node pool.

noah: while we isolate, we should enable model-fallback to a smaller-quantized variant to keep service up for long prompts. set `model_variant=redwood-small-4q` for the affected route.

maria: on it. deploying a temporary rollout: 50% traffic -> small variant, 50% -> current. will also bump prefill-timeout to 30s.

sam: logs (excerpt):
```
2026-03-15T03:22:41Z runtime ERROR: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY at device 0
  at runtime::alloc_kv_cache(size=2147483648)  // prefill length 1.2M tokens
  at serving.cpp:457
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
container_restart: exit code 134
```
noah: wow, 1.2M tokens in prefill. that's the culprit. we should also patch the router to reject >200k prefill tokens with a 413 or auto-truncate.

oncall-sre: agreed. immediate mitigation plan: (1) route away from quarantined nodes, (2) set fallback to quantized model, (3) apply request-level hard cap at 250k tokens for prefill. executing now.

maria: rolled out fallback; 60% of affected pods now serving redwood-small-4q. errors on long prompts dropped by ~85% in the staging mirrors.

eng-infra-bot: routing policy update applied: traffic_weight(variant:current)=40, variant:small-4q=60 for route /v1/generate on cluster us-west-2.

sam: applied request cap proxy rule: `max_prefill_tokens=250000` (returns 413 with guidance). pushing to prod.

noah: also bumped autoscaler to add 4 more nodes for buffer and set eviction threshold to 85% mem to avoid hard restarts.

oncall-sre: customer comms: drafting note — impacted users may see failures for >250k token requests. we're mitigating with model fallback and temporary caps. ETA for full fix: 6-12h while we add better runtime prefill trimming and a quota.

maria: follow-up tasks (action items):
- collect top request ids that caused OOMs and ask customer to trim or split (maria)
- implement server-side safe-trim for prefill longer than N tokens (sam)
- add metric alert for prefill token distribution (noah)
- permanent policy: fail fast on requests above 1M tokens in router (oncall-sre)

sam: quick patch planned: if prefill_estimated_tokens > 500k then attempt KV prefix trim by dropping repeated context blocks, then retry once. i'll open PR and attach benchmark.

noah: pushing a monitoring dashboard for prefill token histogram and per-node mem headroom. will add an alert: ratio of OOM restarts > 0.05 over 1m.

eng-infra-bot: hotfix commands executed summary:
- labeled nodes gpu-node-7..9 quarantine=oom
- routing weights updated
- proxy rule `max_prefill_tokens=250000` in place
- model fallback rollout 60% small-4q

oncall-sre: Incident status: mitigation active, errors reduced by 80% in 20 minutes. paging will continue until stables for 1h. assigning follow-ups.

maria: sending initial customer DM to the impacted tenant with recommended workaround (split prompt, use chunked calls). :email:

sam: PR #3482 opened for safe-trim, linking perf tests.

noah: will do post-incident postmortem and include timeline + trigger + proposed permanent fixes.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigating, severity=P1, pages=1, start_ts=2250008888, last_update_ts=2250013600.

oncall-sre: marking this thread for follow-up postmortem. thanks everyone for fast response. :thumbsup:
